parts.html: The K-28 kitchen is a modern U-shaped design in a brown palette, built on a combination of two front finishes. The upper cabinets feature a woodgrain decor, while the remaining fronts have a solid brown surface. This approach gives the furniture depth and combines the warmth of wood texture with the clean geometry of a contemporary kitchen.
The solid-color fronts of the other cabinets keep the composition cohesive. The kitchen can be complemented with light wall finishes, ceramic tile, stone, and neutral tones.

The key layout feature of the K-28 is its U-shaped configuration. The furniture runs along three sides, so work surfaces and storage can be distributed across several sections. This layout makes it possible to create separate zones for food prep, cooking, and built-in appliances.
A cargo pull-out for food and kitchen utensils is already included in the standard configuration.

Hinged doors are fitted with Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms. Pull-out elements run on Muller telescopic slides without soft-close mechanisms. Cabinet handles are included. There are no lift-up mechanisms.
Upper fronts: Laminated chipboard, woodgrain decor
Lower fronts: Laminated chipboard, solid brown decor
Decor: Combination — woodgrain upper cabinets, all other fronts in a solid color
Drawer slides: Muller telescopic, without soft-close
We will make the K-28 to fit your room — with different side lengths, your own combination of woodgrain and solid-color decor, and hardware at the level you need.
